name: DCA Studio Catering Co. (Hollywood Land) Kids' Turkey Sandwich or Seasonal Mild Slider
brandOrRestaurant: Studio Catering Co. (Hollywood Land · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Hollywood Land's walk-up catering truck consistently offers a simple Kids' Turkey Sandwich or mild slider alongside rotating seasonal items.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Check the current seasonal menu in the app; stick to the plain Turkey Sandwich or un-spiced slider and swap Mandarin Oranges for applesauce.
watchOuts: Avoid seasonal spicy buffalo/jalapeño loaded fries
